verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly advertises native sync with QuickBooks, Xero, and NetSuite plus AI-powered book-closing automations, and its API exposes transaction/category/statement endpoints that support accounting integrations. However, there is no independent or hands-on evidence confirming how the sync works, its reliability, or its scope beyond the marketing claim. Missing for 10: hands-on/community verification of the QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite sync, details on sync frequency/automation depth, and evidence of expense-categorization accuracy in practice.
